fairness.baseline: ordinary persistent same-capacity LRU-B weight-row buffer

findings.finding: The sealed M1707 payload was independently replayed in full: 40 samples, four sequences, 32 captured layers, 960 FC1/FC2 pairs, 11,040 binary frames, and 44,640,000 tokens. Every zlib extent, CRC, support/nnz relation, and nonzero code stream passed.
findings.impact: The TSBG opportunity is bound to the ep34 checkpoint/capture identity rather than inferred from aggregate sparsity statistics.

findings.finding: For every B2/B4/B8 comparison, both arms use an ordinary persistent LRU-B row buffer with the same B-row weight capacity, eight 16-byte/cycle banks, weight ports, compute issue work, and Acc24 commit work. The baseline is not an uncached K1 stream.
findings.impact: The old 2.904x/5.122x screening roofline is not reused; the new serialized ratios are independently reproduced under the strengthened baseline.

findings.finding: All 15 all/sequence rows were independently recomputed from the binary payload and match the sealed result exactly. The 93 result rows also partition exactly into one all, four sequence, two family, and 24 layer rows per B point.
findings.impact: No missing sequence/layer, duplicate aggregation, formula rounding, cache-hit, bank-byte, weight-byte, or serialized-cycle discrepancy was found.

iscas_assessment.projected_role: Embed as the FC memory-specialization inside C2; do not advertise TSBG as a fourth independent contribution or as a first-in-literature weight-row broadcast.
iscas_assessment.strong_accept_gap: B4 still needs exact RTL protocol evidence, matched area including the extra contexts, SRAM/row-buffer timing, and mapped energy. A cycle-accurate B4 result must replace, not relabel, the CPU serialized premodel.

limitations: B2/B4/B8 are fair within-point cache-capacity comparisons, but the three DSE points are not mutually equal-area configurations.
Candidate state exceeds the corresponding baseline by at most 3,388 B, 10,164 B, and 23,716 B for B2, B4, and B8; logic, SRAM macros, fanout, arbitration, tags, and timing are not synthesized.
The serialized CPU model prices all modeled stages without overlap and is not an RTL backpressure trace, measured latency, energy, frame time, or system speedup.
The captured signed codes and INT8 weight-row service are a hardware design point, not a model-bit-exact or trained-quantization authority.

rtl_source_ruling.B4: SELECT_SOURCE_ONLY__requires a new fail-closed contract before any RTL edit and a separate reviewed launch before VCS/EDA
rtl_source_ruling.B8: NO_FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION__retain as upper CPU DSE because the 23,716 B incremental state and same-area physical cost are unresolved

verdict: PASS evidence; select B4 only for the next source-design milestone. Keep B2/B8 as DSE and keep every current number CPU-premodel-only.
